description: Use this for a Telegram gift collection such as "Plush Pepe": lowest published price estimate in Stars, TON and USD, supply, the 24h and 7d change of its lowest ask (there is no longer price history), and its models with their price estimates and rarity. Do not use it for market-wide rankings (top_collections) or for current listings (where_to_buy).

name.description: Collection name in English or Russian, for example "Plush Pepe".

name: get_collection

change_24h_percent.description: Percent change of the lowest ask over 24 hours, from the stored floor change log; null when there was no ask then. See change_basis / caveat.

change_7d_percent.description: Percent change of the lowest ask over 7 days, from the stored floor change log; null when there was no ask then. See change_basis / caveat.

title: Get a gift collection
